title: ornithogalum exscapum var. biflorum
intro: Ornithogalum exscapum var. biflorum, commonly known as the Cape star flower, is a flowering plant species within the Asparagaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to relax the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of Ornithogalum exscapum var. biflorum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
